description.subtitle: FC Barcelona Nike Short Sleeve Women's Cotton T-Shirt x Kobe Bryant - Black
description.tagline: Estilo FCB x Mamba dentro y fuera del campo
description.intro: The Nike Barcelona Kobe Bryant women's shirt links Kobe Bryant's legacy with the FC Barcelona identity in a casual garment designed for those who live the sport with passion. Its design incorporates an exclusive graphic from the Mamba collection, reflecting the competitive character and ambition shared by two world sports leaders.
key_benefits: High quality cotton: Soft touch and comfort throughout the day.
Wide cut: Relaxed adjustment that favors freedom of movement.
Estilo casual: Perfecta para combinar con cualquier look deportivo o urbano.
FC Barcelona Design: Print inspired by Kobe Bryant's legacy and the Blaugrana identity.
